Proposition argue for the motion; opposition argue against it.
Answering and challenging the other side's points: attack the argument, not the person.
Salutation → opening (hook + purpose) → body (2-4 supported points) → conclusion (summary + call to action / thanks).
Most senior first: Guest of Honour, Head, staff, parents, fellow pupils.
Direct address, rhetorical questions, rule of three, repetition, discourse markers, relevant examples.
Madam Chairperson, honourable judges, worthy opponents… / I stand before you to support (oppose) the motion… / I urge you to vote… I thank you.
Eye contact, clear pace and volume, pauses after key points, cue cards not a script, keep to time.
